episodes.title: The Murder
episodes.summary: Two former students launch a dogged investigation into the cold case of Sister Catherine Cesnik, a nun who was slain in Baltimore in 1969.

episodes.title: The School
episodes.summary: Now grown, survivors describe sexual abuse at the hands of a predatory priest and how his actions may have led to Sister Catherine's murder.

episodes.title: The Revelation
episodes.summary: In 1992, one survivor finds the strength to face the abuse she suffered and to disclose an appalling threat that frightened her into silence.

episodes.title: The Burial
episodes.summary: In 1994, two former students file charges against the accused priest, but they face intimidation and powerful resistance from their archdiocese.

episodes.title: The Suspects
episodes.summary: A tip line yields compelling stories that point the group's investigation to two more men who might have been involved in Sister Catherine's murder.

episodes.title: The Web
episodes.summary: As Catherine's younger sister joins the cause, the group tries to get straight answers from authorities and additional potential suspects.

episodes.title: The Conclusion
episodes.summary: As survivors and victims' families seek closure, they face frustrating law enforcement bureaucracy and a legislative fight with their archdiocese.
